purpose:
Adjudicate customer return and refund eligibility across Tesco Help pages
(change of mind, faulty, online vs in-store, chilled/frozen, Whoosh, gift cards,
mobile) — decide GOVERNED vs UNGOVERNED for a support ticket, without inventing
goodwill or competitor price-match rules that the pages do not state.
grain_statement: One node = a return or refund eligibility condition stated on Tesco Help that can decide GOVERNED vs UNGOVERNED for a support ticket.

subjects.subject: Change-of-mind online grocery / GM
subjects.quote: You can return most online grocery and General Merchandise items within 14 days of delivery if you change your mind.

subjects.subject: Faulty / not as described
subjects.quote: If an item is faulty, damaged, or not as described, you may be entitled to a repair, replacement, or refund under your legal rights.

subjects.subject: Chilled and frozen
subjects.quote: Chilled and frozen food bought online usually cannot be returned for change of mind once delivered, because of food safety.

too_fine: One node per sentence on every Help page, including refund timing and contact chrome.
too_coarse: One node for “Tesco returns” covering every channel, product class, and journey step.

exemplars.label: Change of mind · 14 days
exemplars.text_content: Customer requests a change-of-mind return for eligible online GM within 14 days, unused, original packaging where required.
exemplars.quote: return most online grocery and General Merchandise items within 14 days of delivery if you change your mind

exemplars.label: Faulty item · legal rights
exemplars.text_content: Customer reports a fault after delivery; entitlement is repair, replacement, or refund under legal rights — not limited to the change-of-mind window.
exemplars.quote: Faulty returns are not limited to the change-of-mind window.

exemplars.label: Chilled · fused (edit me)
exemplars.text_content: Chilled/frozen cannot be returned for change of mind, and also Whoosh and gift cards follow the same 14-day grocery window with store drop-off. (Fused — split or correct before confirm.)
exemplars.quote: Chilled and frozen food bought online usually cannot be returned for change of mind once delivered

exemplars.label: Gift cards non-refundable
exemplars.text_content: Gift cards and e-vouchers are generally non-refundable once purchased except where law requires (e.g. faulty).
exemplars.quote: Gift cards and e-vouchers are generally non-refundable once purchased, except where required by law

alternative_cut.grain_statement: One node = one Tesco Help article / topic page (returning online, faulty, Whoosh, gift cards, …).

subjects.subject: Help page
subjects.quote: Use Your orders or Help chat for return eligibility questions.

subjects.subject: Whoosh page
subjects.quote: Whoosh orders follow Whoosh return rules.

alternative_cut.rejected_because: Purpose is ticket adjudication (GOVERNED vs UNGOVERNED), not mapping the Help IA. Page-per-node fuses multiple eligibility rules and weakens attribution.

ambiguity.reason: FAQ prose is diffuse — eligibility-rule cut fits purpose; page cut is the easy derive trap.

reference_health.coverage: 4 seeds · multi-page FAQ · one fused body
reference_health.note: Advisory — thin is expected on this corpus; edit before spend.
